```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML

subject = params["subject"]
export_dir = Path(params["export_dir"])
metrics = json.loads((export_dir / f"{subject}_metrics.json").read_text())

directions_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_directions.csv"
sliding_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_sliding_dci.csv"
source_dirs_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_directions.csv"
source_dci_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_dci.csv"
source_roi_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_source_roi_summary.csv"
trials_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_trials.csv"
joined_path = export_dir / f"{subject}_trials_joined.csv"

directions = pd.read_csv(directions_path) if directions_path.exists() else None
sliding = pd.read_csv(sliding_path) if sliding_path.exists() else None
source_dirs = pd.read_csv(source_dirs_path) if source_dirs_path.exists() else None
source_dci = pd.read_csv(source_dci_path) if source_dci_path.exists() else None
source_roi = pd.read_csv(source_roi_path) if source_roi_path.exists() else None
trials = pd.read_csv(trials_path) if trials_path.exists() else None
joined = pd.read_csv(joined_path) if joined_path.exists() else None
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(lmerTest)
library(readr)

theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#1e293b"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 10, color = "#475569")
    )
}

COND_COLORS <- c("ZINNEN" = "#2563eb", "WOORDEN" = "#16a34a", "REST" = "#d97706")
subject <- params$subject
export_dir <- params$export_dir
```

def _fmt(v):
    if isinstance(v, float):
        return f"{v:.4g}"
    return str(v)

rows = [
    {"Metric": _labels.get(k, k), "Value": _fmt(metrics[k])}
    for k in _labels
    if k in metrics
]
pd.DataFrame(rows).style.hide(axis="index")

## Wave Direction Distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-directions
#| fig-cap: "Polar histograms of wave propagation directions per condition (36 bins)."
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 4

dirs_file <- file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_directions.csv"))
if (file.exists(dirs_file)) {
  dirs <- read_csv(dirs_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ggplot(dirs, aes(x = direction_rad, fill = condition)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 36, position = "identity", alpha = 0.75, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    coord_polar() +
    facet_wrap(~condition, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
    theme_mous() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Wave direction distributions -", subject),
      subtitle = "Each panel shows the angular distribution of sensor-space traveling waves",
      x = NULL, y = "Count"
    )
} else {
  cat("No direction CSV found.\n")
}
```

## Sliding DCI

```{r}
#| label: fig-sliding-dci
#| fig-cap: "Directionality Consistency Index (DCI) over time for ZINNEN trials. Dashed line = chance (0.5)."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3.5

slide_file <- file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_sliding_dci.csv"))
if (file.exists(slide_file)) {
  slide <- read_csv(slide_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ggplot(slide, aes(x = time_s, y = dci)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0.5, ymax = pmax(dci, 0.5)), fill = "#bfdbfe", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line(color = "#2563eb", linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8", linewidth = 0.7) +
    theme_mous() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Sliding DCI - ZINNEN:", subject),
      subtitle = "Blue shading = above-chance directionality",
      x = "Time (s)", y = "DCI"
    )
} else {
  cat("No sliding DCI CSV found.\n")
}
```

# Aim 1 - Trial-level Readiness

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

trials_file <- file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials.csv"))
if (file.exists(trials_file)) {
  trials <- read_csv(trials_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  req_cols <- c("prestim_beta", "condition", "pos_in_block", "block_id")
  if (all(req_cols %in% names(trials))) {
    trials$condition <- factor(trials$condition)
    fit <- lmer(prestim_beta ~ condition + pos_in_block + (1 | block_id), data = trials)
    summary(fit)
  } else {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, names(trials))
    knitr::asis_output(
      paste0(
        "Aim 1 model skipped (missing trial columns): ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("Trials CSV not available; Aim 1 model skipped.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-prestim-beta
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of pre-stimulus beta power across conditions."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4.5

if (file.exists(trials_file)) {
  trials <- read_csv(trials_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  req_cols <- c("prestim_beta", "condition")
  if (all(req_cols %in% names(trials))) {
    trials$condition <- factor(trials$condition)
    ggplot(trials, aes(x = condition, y = prestim_beta, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
      geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.6) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
      scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS) +
      theme_mous() +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Pre-stimulus beta power by condition -", subject),
        subtitle = "Mixed-effects model controls for position-in-block and block random effects",
        x = NULL, y = "Pre-stim beta power (a.u.)"
      )
  } else {
    cat("No prestim_beta/condition columns found; Aim 1 figure skipped.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No trial-level CSV found; Aim 1 figure skipped.\n")
}
```

# Aim 2 - MEG-fMRI Coupling

```{r}
#| code-fold: true

joined_file <- file.path(export_dir, paste0(subject, "_trials_joined.csv"))
if (file.exists(joined_file)) {
  joined <- read_csv(joined_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  req_cols <- c("mtg_beta", "prestim_beta", "n400m", "dci_trial", "condition", "pos_in_block", "block_id")
  if (all(req_cols %in% names(joined))) {
    joined$condition <- factor(joined$condition)
    fit <- lmer(
      mtg_beta ~ prestim_beta + n400m + dci_trial + condition + pos_in_block + (1 | block_id),
      data = joined
    )
    summary(fit)
  } else {
    missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, names(joined))
    knitr::asis_output(
      paste0(
        "Aim 2 model skipped (missing joined columns): ",
        paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
} else {
  knitr::asis_output("Joined MEG-fMRI CSV not available; Aim 2 model skipped.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-meg-fmri-scatter
#| fig-cap: "MEG pre-stimulus beta power versus left-MTG fMRI beta weight."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

if (file.exists(joined_file)) {
  joined <- read_csv(joined_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  req_cols <- c("prestim_beta", "mtg_beta", "condition")
  if (all(req_cols %in% names(joined))) {
    joined$condition <- factor(joined$condition)
    ggplot(joined, aes(x = prestim_beta, y = mtg_beta, color = condition)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 1.8) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.15) +
      scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLORS, name = "Condition") +
      theme_mous() +
      theme(legend.position = "right") +
      labs(
        title = paste("MEG-fMRI coupling -", subject),
        subtitle = "Pre-stimulus beta power predicts left-MTG BOLD response",
        x = "Pre-stim beta power (MEG, a.u.)",
        y = "Left-MTG beta weight (fMRI)"
      )
  } else {
    cat("No prestim_beta/mtg_beta/condition columns found; Aim 2 figure skipped.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No joined trial CSV found; Aim 2 figure skipped.\n")
}
```
